content.title: About
content.content: Coffee creamer powder, flavored (406) is a dry substitute for liquid cream designed to enhance the taste and texture of coffee. The powder dissolves quickly in hot or cold beverages, giving them a creamy smoothness and the selected flavor (vanilla, caramel, hazelnut, etc.).

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Powdered creamer is easier to store and transport than liquid cream.
Flavorings can be natural or artificial depending on the formulation.
The fat content is usually lower than in traditional cream, making it more suitable for diet drinks.
It is widely used in commercial coffee shops to ensure consistent flavor across large volumes.
A broad range of flavors is available: vanilla, caramel, hazelnut, chocolate, spice blends.

items.title: Improved flavor
items.content: Flavored powder adds a smoother, sweeter taste to coffee, reducing the need for added sugar.

items.title: Convenient usage
items.content: Easy to dose, requires no refrigeration and retains its properties for a long time.

items.title: Lower calorie option
items.content: Compared with whole cream, the powder often contains fewer calories and less fat.

items.title: Texture enhancement
items.content: Creates a creamy foam and improves the mouthfeel of the drink.

items.title: Stable storage
items.content: Does not spoil quickly and does not need cold storage.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Some formulas contain dry milk, which can trigger reactions in people with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: Artificial flavorings
items.content: Synthetic flavors may cause sensitivity in susceptible consumers.

items.title: Additive overload
items.content: Certain versions may include stabilizers and emulsifiers that should be consumed in moderation.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add 1‑2 teaspoons of powder to hot or cold coffee and stir until fully dissolved. Increase the dose for a richer taste. The powder also works well in lattes, cappuccinos, dessert drinks, and cocktails.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. When stored properly, the shelf life is 12‑18 months. After opening, close the package tightly to prevent moisture absorption.
